proof_body:
by
  intro R M N _ _ _ _ _ a b hc ha hb t
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [hx, hy, add_zero]
  | tmul m n =>
    obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := hc
    calc m ⊗ₜ[R] n = (u * a + v * b) • (m ⊗ₜ[R] n) := by rw [huv, one_smul]
      _ = u • (a • (m ⊗ₜ[R] n)) + v • (b • (m ⊗ₜ[R] n)) := by rw [add_smul, mul_smul, mul_smul]
      _ = 0 := by
        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', ha m, TensorProduct.zero_tmul, ← TensorProduct.tmul_smul, hb n, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
        simp
target_source: ∀ (R M N : Type*) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R M] [Module R N] (a b : R), IsCoprime a b → (∀ m : M, a • m = 0) → (∀ n : N, b • n = 0) → ∀ t : TensorProduct R M N, t = 0
